title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content:
Hi warga threads!

We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project

Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out.

We're looking for artists that draws
- Anime / manga style illustrations
- Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration
- Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork
- Semi-realistic illustrations
- and any other art styles

Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: Temmycreative
title: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid) for Halloween design
content:
Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid)

Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt.

Requirements:

* One skeleton as the main character
* Punk/rock retro horror vibe
* Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS)
* Large back print (13” × 16”)
* Neon green, purple & orange palette
* Original artwork only (no tracing existing designs)

Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price.
